job_description:
We are looking for an experienced SAP Developer to support development, customization, integration, and technical activities within an SAP cloud environment. The candidate should have strong SAP development experience, preferably with ABAP, S/4HANA, SAP BTP, and cloud-based integrations .
Key Responsibilities
• Develop and maintain SAP applications, enhancements, interfaces, and reports.
• Perform ABAP development including reports, forms, enhancements, BAdIs, user exits, and APIs.
• Develop and support integrations between SAP and external systems.
• Work with SAP S/4HANA Cloud and SAP BTP where required.
• Develop and consume APIs, web services, and OData services.
• Analyze technical requirements and prepare technical specifications.
• Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues.
• Work closely with functional consultants to deliver technical solutions.
• Support testing, deployment, cutover, and go-live activities.
• Ensure development follows SAP standards and cloud best practices
Requirements
• 5+ years of SAP development experience.
• Strong hands‑on experience with ABAP.
• Experience with SAP S/4HANA.
• Experience with SAP Cloud / S/4HANA Cloud.
• Knowledge of SAP BTP, APIs, OData, and integrations is preferred.
• Strong understanding of SAP development standards and best practices.
Mandatory Certification
• Valid SAP Cloud certification is mandatory.
• Candidate must provide the exact certification name and credential/certificate ID
